SELECT
    year,
    online_sales_amount,
    orders_count,
    online_sales_amount - lagInFrame(online_sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS yoy_sales_change,
    round(
        100.0 * (online_sales_amount - lagInFrame(online_sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year))
        / nullIf(lagInFrame(online_sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year), 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_sales_growth_pct
FROM
(
    SELECT
        toYear(DateKey) AS year,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS online_sales_amount,
        countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) AS orders_count
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY year
)
ORDER BY year;
